caption: Search by job title, skill or employer.
The count at the top updates as you go.
Pick a town to stay close to home.
Filters combine: here, full-time nursing jobs in Eugene.
Each button shows how many openings it would add.
Clear all filters to start over.
Fewer barriers filters narrow the list together.
Near an LTD bus stop: the workplace is about a quarter mile or less from a stop.
Add No degree needed: now jobs must match both.
Every job shown is near transit and open to people without a degree.
Fair-chance employer: a confirmed fair-chance policy, or a posting that says a record won't rule you out.
Training provided: paid or on-the-job training, or an apprenticeship.
Each listing shows the job, the employer, the town and the hours.
"Pay:" means the employer posted this pay.
"Pay not listed" shows the Lane County average for that kind of job, clearly marked.
"Link checked" means we opened the posting and it was still up.
View and apply opens the original posting. The note says where the application goes.
And this shows how long ago the job was posted.
Make a list for someone: pick up to 12 jobs for a client.
Copy a link, show a QR code, or print a one-page list.
The QR code opens the same list on a phone.
Something wrong with a listing? Choose "Let us know".
Pick the job and what's wrong. We fix or remove listings that are wrong.
